title: B3: align sensor changed-files filter + verify push-trigger end to end
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md — Workstream B, steps 2, 4, 5 (epic tk-vau).

The deployed Sensor board-games-sync fires only when body.metadata.annotations.changed-files EXACTLY equals 'Yuri/Resources/Board Games/Inventory'. From the first Succeeded vault-sync (needs B2), read the real annotation format:
- exact folder → sensor already matches, nothing to do;
- any other format (list/JSON/extra paths) → relax: drop the changed-files data filter in chart/templates/workflow.yaml Sensor and trigger on every Succeeded vault-sync (sync is idempotent, fingerprint-deduped, mutex-serialized).

Document the contract in a chart comment: vault-sync must annotate changed-files and Succeed; board-games reacts.

Accepted tradeoff (per Yuri): with the cron gone, new GCal availability blocks reach the site only on the next vault push or booking action (/game/:id/book re-syncs calendar in-app, src/index.ts:294).
notes: From the first Succeeded vault-sync (obsidian-vault-sync-1788662100): changed-files annotation is a semicolon-joined FILE list (empty diff -> ';') — the exact-match-on-folder filter could never fire. Removed the data filter from the chart Sensor (chart/templates/workflow.yaml); now every Succeeded vault-sync triggers a board-games sync (idempotent + mutex-serialized + content-gated). Contract documented in the dependency comment; EventSource comment updated. helm lint + full render verified. E2E live verification (push -> board-games-sync fires -> visible on bg.syscd.live) requires the new Sensor to be deployed — folded into D1 verification.
acceptance_criteria: Push a real vault commit touching the inventory folder → obsidian-vault-sync Succeeds → a board-games-sync-<generated> workflow auto-submits and Succeeds → the change visible on bg.syscd.live within ~a minute. Rapid successive pushes → mutex serializes, no duplicate concurrent syncs. Push touching an unrelated folder → either filtered (exact-match kept) or a harmless idempotent sync runs (relaxed).
